title: NCL Mine Surveyor Mock 04
pattern: 100 MCQs, 100 marks, 90 min, NO negative marking

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The refraction correction makes objects appear
questions.solution: Higher than true position.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The semi-diameter correction applies to solar observations because
options: It is a point source of light
The sun has appreciable angular diameter
questions.solution: The sun has appreciable angular diameter.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: An observation for latitude can be made by measuring
questions.solution: Meridian altitude of a star.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The gyro theodolite accuracy is approximately
questions.solution: Approximately 10-20 seconds.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The vernal equinox is the point where the ecliptic crosses the celestial equator going
questions.solution: Going north.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The first vertical is the great circle passing through
options: The zenith and the north-south points
The zenith and the east-west points
questions.solution: Through zenith and east-west points.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The parallax correction is significant mainly for
options: Distant celestial objects like the sun
Objects at a very great distance
questions.solution: Significant for nearby objects like the moon.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The standard parallel in a map projection is the
options: Parallel at which projection is tangent to the sphere
The parallel of latitude nearest the pole
The parallel at which distortion is maximum
The parallel passing through the centre of the map
questions.solution: Parallel at which projection is tangent.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The central meridian in a map projection is the
options: The parallel at which the projection is tangent
Meridian at which projection is tangent
questions.solution: Meridian at which projection is tangent.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The altitude method for longitude determination uses
options: Observation of the sun at noon
Simultaneous observation of a star at two stations
questions.solution: Simultaneous observation at two stations.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: An observation for azimuth by stellar observation requires
options: An accurate theodolite and star catalog
questions.solution: Accurate theodolite and star catalog.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The astronomical observation for azimuth is more accurate than magnetic compass because
options: It is unaffected by cloud cover
It gives true bearing independent of local magnetic disturbances
It can be carried out in daylight
questions.solution: Independent of local magnetic disturbances.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A map projection is the systematic transformation of
options: The curved surface of Earth to a flat map
The magnetic declination of the region
The altitude of points above sea level
questions.solution: Curved surface of Earth to a flat map.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Cassini projection is a
questions.solution: Transverse cylindrical projection.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Cassini projection is tangent along a
questions.solution: Tangent along a meridian.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Lamberts conical projection uses
options: One or two cones tangent to the sphere
A cylinder tangent along the equator
Two parallel planes tangent to the poles
questions.solution: One or two cones tangent to the sphere.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Lamberts projection is conformal when
options: When the cone is tangent at a single point
When the standard parallels are equally spaced
questions.solution: When standard parallels are correctly chosen.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The UTM system divides the world into
questions.solution: 60 zones of 6 degrees each.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Each UTM zone is
questions.solution: 6 degrees wide.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The UTM projection is based on
questions.solution: Transverse Mercator projection.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A conformal projection preserves
questions.solution: Preserves angles locally.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: An equal area projection preserves
questions.solution: Preserves areas.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The true scale on a map projection occurs at
options: The line or point of tangency
questions.solution: At the line or point of tangency.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A scale factor in map projection is the ratio of
options: Ground distance divided by map distance
Area on map to area on ground
questions.solution: Ratio of map distance to ground distance.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The central meridian of a UTM zone has a scale factor of
questions.solution: Scale factor of 0.9996.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The false easting in UTM is added to avoid
questions.solution: To avoid negative coordinates.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The false northing in UTM for southern hemisphere is
questions.solution: 10000000 meters.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Cassini projection was historically used for
questions.solution: Topographic mapping in India.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Mercator projection is suitable for
options: Navigation where rhumb lines are straight
questions.solution: Navigation (rhumb lines are straight).

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A gnomonic projection projects from
questions.solution: From the center of the sphere.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: On a stereographic projection the projection point is
options: At the opposite point on the sphere
questions.solution: At the opposite point on the sphere.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A vertical projection in mine surveying shows
options: A horizontal section of the workings
questions.solution: Vertical section of workings.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A mine model in 3D represents
options: The geological features found at the surface
The 3D geometry of ore body, workings, and geological features
questions.solution: 3D geometry of ore body, workings, and features.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Indian Grid system is based on
options: The Polyconic projection of the Survey of India
questions.solution: Lamberts conical projection.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The datum in geodesy refers to
questions.solution: A reference surface for coordinates.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The WGS 84 datum is used for
questions.solution: Used for GPS globally.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Everest spheroid was used as the reference for
questions.solution: Indian survey.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The orthometric height is measured from
questions.solution: From geoid (mean sea level) to the point.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The dynamic height is defined as
options: The geometric height above the ellipsoid
The height measured along the vertical
Work done per unit mass to raise from geoid to the point
questions.solution: Work done per unit mass from geoid to point.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The geoid is an equipotential surface that
options: Is a flattened sphere with local undulations
Approximately coincides with mean sea level
questions.solution: Approximately coincides with mean sea level.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The spheroid or ellipsoid is used to represent
options: The shape of the Earth as an oblate body
questions.solution: Shape of Earth as an oblate body.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The flattening of the Earth spheroid is approximately
questions.solution: Approximately 1/298.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: As per MVTR 1966, refresher vocational training must be given to persons employed in mines at least once in:
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 8: refresher training at least once in every 5 years.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Survey of India uses which projection for older toposheets
questions.solution: Cassini projection.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The Lambert projection is suitable for countries with
questions.solution: Countries with east-west extent.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The maximum working hours in a week for an adult employed belowground in a mine are:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.28: no person shall be employed belowground for more than 48 hours in any week.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The equidistant projection preserves
options: Angles at the centre of the projection
Distances from one or two points
Areas over the whole of the map
questions.solution: Distances from one or two points.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Photogrammetry is the science of making measurements from
questions.solution: From photographs.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: An aerial photograph is taken from
questions.solution: From an aircraft or drone.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A vertical photograph has the camera axis
options: Inclined at forty five degrees to the vertical
Along the direction of the wind
questions.solution: Camera axis is vertical.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The scale of a vertical photograph depends on
options: The size of the aircraft in flight
Flying height above ground and focal length
questions.solution: Flying height and focal length.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Under the Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966, a person before being employed in a mine for the first time must undergo:
options: Refresher training after one year of service
Initial vocational training in the prescribed subjects
A certificate of fitness from a doctor
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 6: every person is given initial vocational training before first employment.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Photographs differ from maps because photographs show
options: Only the features at the centre
questions.solution: Perspective view with relief displacement.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Relief displacement on a vertical photograph causes
options: Features to be displaced along the flight line
Topographical features to be displaced radially from the center
Features to be displaced tangentially to the photo
questions.solution: Features displaced radially from center.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Tilt displacement on an oblique photograph causes
options: Features to be displaced from their true positions
A uniform shift of all features
Features to be shifted towards the nadir point
questions.solution: Features displaced from true positions.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The relief displacement formula is d = rh/H where r is
options: The height of the terrain above sea level
The horizontal distance from the principal point
Radial distance from the principal point
questions.solution: Radial distance from principal point.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: An oblique photograph is taken with the camera axis
questions.solution: Tilted from the vertical.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Flight planning for aerial photography considers
options: The type of film and camera shutter speed
The fuel capacity and flying speed of the aircraft
Overlap, side lap, flying height, and camera specifications
The amount of cloud cover on the day of flying
questions.solution: Overlap, side lap, height, and camera specs.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Forward overlap in aerial photography is typically
questions.solution: Typically 50-60%.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Side overlap in aerial photography is typically
questions.solution: Typically 20-30%.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The principal point of a photograph is the
options: Point where the optical axis intersects the photograph
questions.solution: Where optical axis intersects photograph.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The nadir point of a vertical photograph coincides with the
questions.solution: Principal point.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: 'Competent person' under the Mines Act 1952 means a person:
options: Appointed by the owner, agent or manager and possessing the prescribed qualifications
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.2(1)(c): a competent person is one appointed by the owner, agent or manager with the prescribed qualifications for the purpose.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Remote sensing involves
options: Collecting information about objects without physical contact
Measuring distances by the chain survey method
Direct field measurement of every feature
questions.solution: Collecting information without physical contact.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The focal length of an aerial camera is typically
questions.solution: Typically 50-300mm.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A stereo pair of photographs allows
questions.solution: 3D viewing and measurement.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A first-aid room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed exceeds:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.21: a first-aid room is required where more than 150 persons are employed.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Base to height ratio (B/H) in photogrammetry affects
questions.solution: Accuracy of height determination.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A photomosaic is created by
options: Joining adjacent photographs to form a continuous image
questions.solution: Joining adjacent photographs.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Orthophoto is a
options: Photograph corrected for tilt and relief displacement
questions.solution: Corrected for tilt and relief.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Digital photogrammetry uses
options: Analogue cameras and wet chemistry processing
questions.solution: Digital sensors and computer processing.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The flying height for aerial photography depends on
options: The direction of the prevailing wind
The number of crew on board the aircraft
The width of the aircraft and its take-off run
Required scale, terrain, and camera specifications
questions.solution: Required scale, terrain, and camera specs.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A rescue-trained person shall practise with breathing apparatus at least:
options: 8 times a year, of which 4 in mines
4 times a year, of which 2 in mines
questions.solution: MRR 1985: rescue-trained persons practise with breathing apparatus at least 8 times a year, including 4 practices in the mine.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: The radial displacement due to relief is proportional to
options: The height of the object above the datum
questions.solution: Height of object above datum.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A rescue room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed belowground exceeds 100 and:
options: The mine produces less than 100 tonnes a day
There is no rescue station within 35 km
questions.solution: MRR 1985: a rescue room is required when more than 100 persons work belowground and no rescue station is within 35 km.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: Under the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, the breathing apparatus kept at a rescue station or rescue room shall:
options: Be of the same type and make
Be of different types for flexibility
questions.solution: MRR 1985, Rule 11(4): breathing apparatus at a rescue station/room must be of the same type and make for interchangeability.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: As per the Mines Act 1952, women may be employed aboveground only between:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.46: women shall not be employed belowground, and aboveground employment is restricted between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: As per the Mines Rescue Rules 1985, a rescue station shall be under the charge of a Superintendent assisted by at least:
options: 2 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 18 rescue-trained persons
questions.solution: MRR 1985: a rescue station has a Superintendent, at least 2 instructors and a rescue brigade of at least 18 rescue-trained persons.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A shot-firer who has not been employed in blasting duties for more than 6 months shall undergo:
options: Retraining in the handling of explosives before resuming such duties
A practical demonstration at the blasting site
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 13: retraining in handling of explosives is required after an absence from such duties exceeding 6 months.

questions.subject: Mine Surveying
questions.stem: A person re-employed after an absence exceeding one year from mining work must undergo refresher training within:
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 10: refresher training within 1 month of re-employment after absence over 1 year.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The calendar for 2006 is the same as which year?
questions.solution: 2006 is not a leap year. After 2006, the next year with same calendar is 2017 (after 11 years since 2008 and 2012 are leap years)

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The average of 6 observations is 12. If one observation of 15 is replaced by 21, what is the new average?
questions.solution: Original sum = 72. New sum = 72 - 15 + 21 = 78. New average = 78/6 = 13

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A man sells two watches at ₹990 each. One at 10% gain and other at 10% loss. What is his overall gain or loss?
questions.solution: CP1 = 990/1.10 = 900, CP2 = 990/0.90 = 1100. Total CP = 2000, Total SP = 1980. Loss = ₹20. Hmm wait, 20 is in the options... actually: loss% = x²/100 = 1%. 1% of avg CP 1000 = ₹10. But exact: Total loss = ₹20. Option ₹20 loss should be there... Let me recalculate: the answer should be ₹20 loss.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The average age of 30 students is 14 years. Including the teacher, the average becomes 15 years. What is the teacher's age?
questions.solution: Total age of students = 420. With teacher = 31 × 15 = 465. Teacher's age = 45

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The headquarters of the Indian Army is located in:
questions.solution: Indian Army headquarters is in New Delhi.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: International Yoga Day is observed on which date?
questions.solution: International Day of Yoga is celebrated on 21 June.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Who was the first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.solution: Abhinav Bindra won India's first individual Olympic gold in 2008 Beijing (shooting).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which Indian city is known as the 'Silicon Valley of India'?
questions.solution: Bengaluru is known as the Silicon Valley of India due to its IT industry.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: India's first nuclear test was conducted at which place?
questions.solution: India's first nuclear test (Smiling Buddha) was conducted at Pokhran in 1974.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which sport is associated with the Davis Cup?
questions.solution: Davis Cup is an international team event in men's tennis.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The National Sports Day of India is celebrated on which date?
questions.solution: National Sports Day is celebrated on 29 August (Major Dhyan Chand's birthday).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Who was the first Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of India?
options: D. Air Chief Marshal BS Dhanoa
questions.solution: Gen. Bipin Rawat was the first CDS of India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which vitamin deficiency causes scurvy?
questions.solution: Scurvy is caused by Vitamin C deficiency.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The International Labour Day is observed on which date?
questions.solution: International Labour Day is observed on 1 May.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: How many-membered is the UN Security Council (including permanent)?
questions.solution: UN Security Council has 15 members (5 permanent + 10 non-permanent).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: World Environment Day is celebrated on which date?
questions.solution: World Environment Day is celebrated on 5 June.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The Indian Navy Day is celebrated on which date?
questions.solution: Indian Navy Day is celebrated on 4 December to mark Operation Trident in 1971.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which Indian cricketer is known as the 'Little Master'?
questions.solution: Sunil Gavaskar is known as the 'Little Master'.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: The headquarters of the Indian Air Force is in which city?
questions.solution: IAF headquarters is at Vayu Bhawan, New Delhi.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Which of the following is the largest producer of coal in India?
questions.solution: Jharkhand is the largest coal-producing state in India.
